parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Refund Pattern Detector
Runs every Monday.
Fetches refunds + orders from Google Sheets.
Calculates: refund rate, top refunded products, top reasons, serial refunders.
GPT-4o identifies root causes, product issues, fraud signals.
High/medium fraud risk triggers urgent Slack alert.
Weekly digest to #ecommerce channel.
